specs.Item Type Name: Aeoss Portable Smart Ring Charging Case

features: Custom Fit for Smart Rings: Precision-engineered charging dock specifically designed to hold and charge your smart ring securely. The custom-molded interior ensures perfect alignment with the magnetic pins, providing a stable and efficient power transfer.

Plug-and-Play Magnetic Charging: Unlike universal wireless pads, this dedicated dock utilizes a physical magnetic contact system to ensure a faster, more reliable charge every time. Simply snap the ring into place and connect the case to a power source.

Ultra-Portable Design: This case is the perfect travel companion. Its pocket-sized form factor ensures you can carry your charger anywhere, keeping your ring powered throughout your day without adding bulk to your bag or pockets.

Robust & Protective Construction: Crafted with a high-grade ABS hard shell, this case acts as both a charger and a protective travel vault. It shields your smart ring from dust, scratches, and accidental drops when not in use.

Sleek & User-Friendly: The minimalist black aesthetic complements your tech gear, while the smooth hinge and magnetic lid snap provide easy, one-handed access. Note: This is a direct-contact magnetic charging case and does not support wireless/induction charging.
description: Power Your Smart Ring, Anywhere.Never let a dead battery interrupt your day. The Aeoss Portable Charging Case is the essential accessory designed to keep your smart ring powered, protected, and ready to use.Engineered for the modern minimalist, this ultra-compact dock measures just 5cm, slipping effortlessly into your pocket, handbag, or travel kit. Whether you are at the office, the gym, or traveling abroad, this case ensures your device stays charged and protected in a durable, hard-shell exterior.
